description: This file defines the RulesetParameter class, which models an individual parameter within an AWS endpoint ruleset. It manages parameter properties, validation logic, and type checking relevant to AWS endpoint resolution.

classes.name: RulesetParameter
classes.description: Represents a parameter with properties such as name, type, default value, and validation logic within an AWS endpoint ruleset.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a RulesetParameter with its name and definition array, validating the type.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the parameter.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the parameter.

methods.name: getBuiltIn
methods.description: Returns the built-in value associated with the parameter, if any.

methods.name: getDefault
methods.description: Returns the default value for the parameter.

methods.name: getRequired
methods.description: Returns whether the parameter is required.

methods.name: getDocumentation
methods.description: Returns the documentation string for the parameter.

methods.name: getDeprecated
methods.description: Indicates if the parameter is deprecated.

methods.name: validateInputParam
methods.description: Validates an input parameter value against its type and issues warning if deprecated.
